label: Resin
rs.field.hollow: Godso ka dhig, oo leh god neef-gal
rs.resin.note: Tirooyinka iftiin-gelinta iyo kor-u-qaadista waa bilow u ah nooca resin-kan, ma aha kan resin-kaaga. Isticmaal imtixaanka iftiin-gelinta ee hoose si aad kaaga hesho.
rs.printer.note: Shaashadda {w} × {h} pixel, {x} × {y} mm. Kuwani waa cabbirrada ay soo saartaha daabacay: hubi kaaga oo wax ka beddel Custom gudaha.
rs.supports.note: Qaybta waxaa lagu kor-u-qaadaa saldhig, dhinac kasta oo siman oo hoose, dul-ka-baxa iyo qayb kasta oo sabacsan waxaa lagu geeyaa tiirar khafiif ah. Taageerooyinkan waa cusub yihiin oo lama tijaabin daabacaha: fiiri lakabyada ka hor intaadan daabicin.
rs.noformat: Qaabka faylka ee daabacahan wali lama darin. Hoos ku dar mid.
rs.format.unlisted: {printer} lama soo sheegin inuu qaabkan akhriyo. Isticmaal haddii aad og tahay in daabacahaagu akhriyo.
rs.format.options: Haddii daabacahaagu faylka diido, wax ka beddel mid ka mid ah kuwan oo mar kale kaydi, kadibna noo sheeg midka shaqeeyay.
rs.preview.stale: Salka ama dejinta ayaa la beddelay tan iyo jarjarkii ugu dambeeyay. Mar kale hor-eeg lakabyada.
rs.preview.canvas: Lakabka sida shaashaddu u muujin doonto
rs.preview.layer: Lakab {n} oo ka mid ah {total}, {z} mm
rs.stats: {layers} lakab, qiyaastii {time}, {ml} mL oo resin ({g} g, qiyaastii {cost}).
rs.empty: Marka hore wax ku dhig salka.
rs.off: Shaashadda ka baxay: {names}. U dhaqaaq gudaha khadka jajabka ah.
rs.confirm: Kaydi {format}: {layers} lakab, qiyaastii {time}, {ml} mL oo resin.
rs.confirm.untested: Faylkan CadCraft ayaa keliya akhriday. Daabacaha lama soo rarin weli: hubi lakabyada oo daabacaadda ugu horeysa gacanta ku samee.
rs.saved: Waa la kaydiyay {name}: qiyaastii {time}, {ml} mL oo resin. Ku koobiyee daabacaha.
rs.untested: Cusub dhismahan. Faylasha weli lama marin daabacaha.
rs.warn.skipped: {n} qaybood ({share}% qaabka) ma aha jidh xidhan oo waa la reebay.
rs.warn.skipped_one: Hal qayb ({share}% qaabka) ma aha jidh xidhan oo waa la reebay.
rs.warn.sheets: {n} xaashi oo dhumuc lagu siiyay si loo daabaco.
rs.warn.floating: Qaabku wuxuu ka sabacsanaa saxanka; waa la hoos geeyay.
rs.warn.islands: {n} qaybood ma leeyihiin wax hoostooda ah oo way dhici doonaan. Daar taageerooyin, ama janjeer qaabka.
rs.warn.overhangs: Dul-ka-baxa {n} lakab ayaa ka sarreeya xagga la dejiyay, iyada oo aan taageero lahayn.
rs.warn.nodrain: {n} godad xidhan ma heli karin god. Derbiga khafiifi ama godka yaree.
rs.fail.empty: Wax la daabici karo ma jiro.
rs.fail.open: Qaybaha midkood ma aha jidh xidhan.
rs.fail.bed: Ma ku habboonaan shaashadda ama dhererka.
